This Is It: Robert Pattinson Officially Cast As the Next James Bond
13 photos
Photo: Amazon
This is the moment we have all been waiting for, more than seven years, since Daniel Craig first confirmed his exit in 2019. London-born Robert Pattinson has officially been cast as the next James Bond. Amazon MGM Studios announced the 40-year-old British actor as Daniel Craig's successor.
Robert Pattinson goes from Gotham to MI6, becoming the seventh actor to portray the iconic British spy in the film series, joining an elite cast alongside Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan, and Daniel Craig.
The upcoming James Bond movie will be directed by Dune filmmaker Denis Villeneuve, who previously worked with Robert Pattinson on Dune: Part Three. Peaky Blinders creator Steven Knight is writing the screenplay. Amy Pascal and David Heyman will produce the movie.
Pattinson described inheriting the iconic role as " a dream come true " and " the honor of a lifetime. " This marks the first major casting decision since Amazon MGM Studios took creative control of the franchise and launched its casting search in May 2026. It’s been a roller coaster ride, with names such as Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, and Josh O'Connor being shortlisted for the legendary part. Pattinson was not even part of the initial testing pool.
Photo: MovieStation | YouTube Robert Pattinson was born in London, England, following the tradition of casting British actors or those from Commonwealth nations and Ireland as James Bond, a pattern surprisingly continued by Amazon MGM Studios.
However, Amazon makes a major departure from a long-standing unwritten rule: never cast an actor already famous for another iconic franchise role. The English actor has already starred as Bruce Wayne in The Batman in 2022, Edward Cullen in The Twilight Saga from 2008 through 2012, and Cedric Diggory in Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire back in 2005.
Pattinson is currently in cinemas playing the real-life television journalist Chris Hansen in the psychological thriller Primetime. He hits the theaters again in December 2026 with the sci-fi sequel Dune: Part Three, where he plays Scytale.
The new 007 was received with open arms by some critics, while others see his casting as a bad idea. The Guardian film critic Peter Bradshaw called him an " exquisite choice ." On the other hand, television broadcaster Piers Morgan publicly criticized the decision, writing that " Batman can't be Bond too. "
Photo: Warner Bros. Pictures | YouTube Amazon MGM Studios has yet to announce the exact release date for Robert Pattinson's first James Bond movie and the 26th installment of the franchise, but it is widely expected to arrive in cinemas sometime in 2028.
However, Amazon should start working on the new James Bond in 2027, once director Denis Villeneuve finishes his promotional tour for Dune. A 2028 release would mark a seven-year gap since Daniel Craig ’s final outing in No Time to Die, which premiered back in September 2021. This is by far the longest hiatus between films in the 007 series. The title of the upcoming installment is still a work in progress.
